label.en: Chronic idiopathic constipation, adults — 3 mg once daily

label.fa: IBS با یبوست بزرگسال — ۳ mg یک بار
label.en: IBS with constipation, adults — 3 mg once daily

text.fa: کودک زیر ۶ سال (کم‌آبی شدید)؛ انسداد مکانیکی گوارش.
text.en: Children under 6 years (serious dehydration); mechanical GI obstruction.

text.fa: هشدار جعبه‌ای: کم‌آبی شدید در کودکان — زیر ۶ سال منع، ۶ تا ۱۸ سال پرهیز. اسهال شدید.
text.en: Boxed warning: serious dehydration in children — contraindicated under 6 y, avoid 6–<18 y. Severe diarrhoea.

text.fa: برچسب: جذب سیستمیک ناچیز؛ مواجهه جنین انتظار نمی‌رود.
text.en: Label: minimal systemic absorption; fetal exposure not expected.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Plecanatide and its active metabolite are negligibly absorbed systemically following oral administration [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) ] and maternal use is not expected to result in fetal exposure to the drug.

text.fa: برچسب: در شیردهی با احتیاط؛ متن برچسب را ببینید.
text.en: Label: use with caution while breastfeeding; see the label text.

lactation.quote: Risk Summary After administration of multiple doses of TRULANCE 3 mg once daily for 2 weeks to nursing mothers, plecanatide and its active metabolite were not measurable in breast milk collected at 2 hours, 6 hours, and 12 hours post-dosing.

text.fa: برچسب: در کودکان زیر سن مشخص منع مصرف دارد.
text.en: Label: contraindicated in children below a stated age.

pediatric.quote: TRULANCE is contraindicated in: Patients less than 6 years of age due to the risk of serious dehydration [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) , Use in Specific Populations (8.4) ] .

text.fa: برچسب: در سالمندان با احتیاط و معمولاً از دوز پایین شروع شود.
text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: Chronic Idiopathic Constipation (CIC) Of 2,601 subjects in placebo-controlled clinical trials of TRULANCE, 273 (10%) were 65 years of age and over, and 47 (2%) were 75 years and over.
